title: Vietnamese Chicken Wings Wrap
description: A fresh and juicy Vietnamese dish featuring chicken wings, ssam-wrap, and served on a talavera plate, perfect for a quick fix meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger.
Add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray.
Arrange the chicken wings on the baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake the chicken wings for 25-30 minutes or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the ssam wrap by cutting it into smaller pieces.
To assemble the wrap, place a few pieces of the chicken on a ssam wrap, garnish with cilantro, and serve.
Serve the chicken wings wrap on a talavera plate.
Garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
